data.title: Four-Digit Place Value Explorers
data.description: Practice reading four-digit numbers using base-ten blocks, paying special attention to place values and empty columns.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Remember to check the hundreds column carefully when counting the total value.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Count the thousands blocks first, then the hundreds, tens, and ones.

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Look closely at the hundreds place. If there are no flat blocks, what digit goes there?

challenges.instruction: What number do these blocks show?
challenges.hint: Combine the values of all the blocks on the mat to find the total.
